title: Mini Flower Keychain
name: Mini Flower Keychain
subtitle: Beginner Crochet Pattern
tagline: Free crochet pattern | Leftover yarn | Printable
seoTitle: Easy Crochet Flower Keychain Pattern (Free Beginner PDF)
description: Free, easy crochet flower keychain pattern for beginners: a six-petal flower from leftover yarn. Free printable PDF download with a round diagram.
lead: A tiny six-petal flower that's perfect for using up leftover yarn. It uses chains, slip stitches and double crochet, and makes a sweet gift.
yarn: Sport or DK yarn, two colours (centre + petals), a few grams each
materialsTable: Sport or DK yarn in two colours (centre + petals), a few grams each
notes: Change to the petal colour at the start of round 3.
You also need a keyring or lobster clasp.

rounds.text: With the centre colour: 6 sc in mr, sl st to first sc
ch 1, inc x6, sl st to first sc. Fasten off the centre colour.
Join the petal colour in any st. (ch 2, 2 dc in next st, ch 2, sl st in next st) x6
From the tip of any petal: ch 12, sl st back into the same st to make a loop. Fasten off, weave in ends and attach the keyring to the loop.

variations: Make the petals pop by working round 3 in a brighter colour than the centre, or embroider a tiny smile on the centre.
chartNote: The flower from the middle out: centre, increase round, then the six petals.
